A Nordiheimian exploration team rode around in the dessert of what whas belived to be the northern lands of Alkiragunya, they were there to try and find a way to get in contact with the nations council that they had been told whas the leaders of Alkiragunya, be it trough finding them directly or trough there trade caravans that traveled trough there nations.

[i]"Do you see anyone from that dune Olaf?"[/i] Asked Tau.
Olaf pointed towards the south [i]"I'm not sure, I tink I might be seeing someone, but it might also be a mirrage"[/i]
[i]"Then we must get closer so that we can figure out if what you are seeing is real or not"[/i] Tau said as he motioned for the rest of the party to travel southwards towards the potential Alkiragunyas.

 Uma caravana composta de alguns dezenas de pessoas, acompanhados por talvez uma centena de camelos, seguindo uma longa "estrada" nas areas, eles usam roupas longas e grossas que cobrem boa parte de seu corpo abaixo do pescoço , o qual está coberto por um longo cachecol, e em seu rosto há uma bandana que cobre suas bocas e parcialmente o nariz, seus olhos marrons escuros são visíveis, a pele deles é escura.
O aparente líder da caravana se aproximou, retirando sua bandana, revelando marcas causadas pelo sol.
[i] Wunya, homens de terras distantes, oque vós trás à nossa terra?[/i]
Enquanto perguntava ele retirava de um camelo atrás dele e retirou um recipiente de água e os ofereceu.
[i]Precisam de água? Água fresca, recém tirada de um soakage.[/i]
A caravan of a few dozens of people appear at distance, accompanied by about a hundred camels approach, following a "road" on the sands,  they have long cloths covering their entire bodies to protect against Ardagan light(Sunlight), long scarfs  covering their  neck and their face partially covered by a bandanna, their eyes can be seen, brown and dark, their skin is dark, the one leading the group seen the foreigners, approached and removed his bandanna then said 
([i]Wunya[/i](greetings, welcome, heya) [i] men from far lands, what bring you to our land?[/i]
As he remove his bandanna, his face is revealed,  marked by scars of the desert, he takes a recipient of water from a camel behind him  then offers and says says.
[i]Need water?
Freshwater, taken from a soakage.[/i]

As the Nordiheimian group of four ride there camels close enough to the caravan to speak, Tau takes the lead, a man dressed in more modern desert clothes that covers all but the face (like the rest of his group), with blue eyes, black hair barely visible from under his sun protecting hood and a skin color only a shade lighter then the man infront of him, he politely takes the recipient of water and takes a drink before passing it to his 3 other companions before it it respectably returned to the good man with each Nordiheimian saying a [i]"Wela'lin"[/i](Thank you) to him for the generous gift of water.

[i]"We are travelers from Nordiheim in the far west, looking to expand our nations ties and knowledge of the land of Alkiragunya and its people, these are my companions."[/i]
He points at them in turn and says there names
[i]"Olaf"[/i] A robust man with green eyes and brown hair, his skin is the lightest of them all being only a light brown.
[i]"Trym"[/i] While with a sleek build it is easy to see that he is quite tall, his eyes greenish brown and hair dark blond with skin a shade darker then Olaf.
[i]"Djalu"[/i] His build is rather average, but his bright blue eyes and pale blond hair stand out, especialy since his skin is almoust as dark as the Alkarigunyan infront of them.
[i]"And I am Tau, may we know your name kind bunji(friend)?"[/i]

He greets the group in a heavy Sikirskian accent and what your purpose is, then A dressed strong man steps up behind him. He recognizes the classic mainland West-Shamat faces from his old weapon dealing times. He greets you in Sikirskian, then in Albic, which he picked up during his old days. 

[i]Come on in I assume, no worries. [b]He says.[/b][/i][/quote]

Akmal and Rafi would follow the Sikirskian men inside.
We wish to see the oligarchs, is this possible? Says Akmal, who has appeared to have taken charge.
